claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only the Nikon D7000 body (and a lens cap nearby). No test shot, menu/screen, EVF/LCD, or shutter/metering proof is shown.
Photos do not show batteries or battery compartment contents.

claims.claim: I am selling with a silicone case.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show a silicone case.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed functionality (could have shutter, autofocus, metering, or button/port faults).
risks.proof: A short video showing the camera powered on with LCD/EVF view, menu navigation, and a test photo taken (with timestamp).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera body with unknown working status (worst-case: not fully functional).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete kit (no lens shown; batteries/charger/memory card/cables not shown).
risks.proof: Photos laid out clearly: both batteries, charger (if any), memory card, body cap/strap, and any included accessories; plus a photo confirming whether a lens is included or not.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only (or body with only what is visible: lens cap), excluding value for batteries/case.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/transport damage (camera appears placed against damaged cardboard; possible dents/scratches not fully visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top plate, grip, lens mount rim, hot shoe area, and all external corners/edges in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst cosmetic condition consistent with potential handling damage.

risks.risk: Sensor/optics condition unknown (dust, scratches, fungus, or sensor damage).
risks.proof: A sensor test shot (e.g., f/22 on a blank wall/sky) and a close-up of the lens mount contacts; if a lens is available, show front element condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown sensor/optics quality (worst-case: needs cleaning or has issues).

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown (could be high wear).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera showing shutter count (or a shutter count report from a connected software).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear usage due to unknown shutter count.

proof_requests: Show the camera powered on: LCD/EVF working, menu navigation, and a recent test photo (video or photo sequence).
Provide clear photos of the included items: both batteries, silicone case, and any charger/memory card/cables.
Confirm whether a lens is included; if not, show that only the body is for sale and the lens cap is the only lens-related item.
Send close-ups of lens mount area, sensor (or sensor test shot), and all external corners/ports.
Share shutter count (screenshot/report) or a way to verify usage history.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item as a Nikon D7000 DSLR body, but key value drivers (working test, included accessories, sensor condition, shutter count) are not proven by the photos. I can still price it at its worst-case for a used body with unknown functionality and incomplete/uncertain kit, then adjust only after the requested proof.
